name: auto_route_generator
summary: The code generator used by auto_route to generate routing classes and navigation infrastructure from annotated route configuration.
advantages: Generates the strongly-typed routing infrastructure used by auto_route
Also supports LeanBuilder in current releases for incremental generation workflows
tradeoffs: Adds generated source files and a code-generation step
Should only be introduced when the project adopts auto_route's generated workflow
recommendedFor: Projects using auto_route with generated routes
Teams that prefer generated type-safe navigation APIs

verification.reason: The current pub.dev package page and auto_route documentation provide the required generator and builder information.
